title: Advanced Topics in Computer Engineering; Advances in XR
description:
Cross-listed with CMSC731. Credit only granted for CMSC731 or ENEE759N.

AR, VR, and MR, collectively referred to as XR, are becoming ubiquitous for human computer interaction with limitless applications and potential use. This course examines advances on real-time multi-modal XR systems in which the user is 'immersed' in and interacts with a simulated 3D environment. The topics will include display, modeling, 3D graphics, haptics, audio, locomotion, animation, applications, immersion, and presence and how they interact to create convincing virtual environments.
